flows.title: Plugin discovery and lifecycle
flows.summary: Emby discovers plugin/providers/services; PluginEntryPoint connects runtime services, hooks, caches, workers and timers. Reflection targets remain runtime capabilities, not build guarantees. A dedicated pre-startup entrypoint installs personal visibility before HTTP is opened; operational jobs stay in ordinary startup. After catalog reset, early startup restores key-free admin handle identities and resolves missing mappings with a bounded cache-first bootstrap before HTTP opens; it does not depend on a provider root refresh. Normal startup then schedules one coordinated root-materialization migration independent of assembly-version stamps; success requires a current provider-root observation and matching fresh native rows after actual registered-provider refresh completion.

flows.title: Settings and refresh
flows.summary: The AMD view serializes autosaves to the custom Admin endpoint; Plugin normalizes/persists settings and refreshes only content-affecting changes using shared configuration hashing. Saves/hash polls and profile eligibility changes signal the root coordinator synchronously. Legacy upgrade/surface notices share that coordinator; genuine playlist-content polling remains separate. Strict native refresh owns the shared gate/activity unit until true completion.

flows.title: Channel tree and media construction
flows.summary: The partial channel routes folder IDs, pages and enriches videos, classifies Shorts/live entries and persists stable watch-page identities. Direct mode replaces playback sources through a dynamic callback. Trending and live folders have distinct aggregate/probe paths.

flows.title: Native media, bounded quality, compatible audio/video and captions
flows.summary: Enabled direct mode resolves VOD media inside Emby through a pinned source-compiled managed adapter, bounded HTTP, shared flights and request backoff. The resolver extracts no executable and uses no subprocess or program updater. Harmony retains its approved temporary native helper exception; ordinary Emby cache/settings remain outside the DLL. Sources/output retain1080p compatibility bounds; client and global Emby bitrate limits are not overridden. A separately measured CDN budget selects startup HLS/HTTPS quality, not continuous ABR. A denied/invalid HLS master is not bypassed. Native Emby transcoding owns resume; late corrective seeks and watch-player fallback are disabled. Deterministic audio identities expose actual supported original/dub tracks and map only the selected audio input with the video timeline. Encoded output retains30fps compatibility safeguards. Each new native playback defaults subtitles Off; missing source identity is bound before Emby negotiates the actual URL. CurrentPlaySessionId preserves manual choices. Only unprepared metadata receives an Off projection; prepared selections are not disguised. The existing scoped native caption-rendering compatibility policy is retained; this repair does not remove the TV fallback or introduce browser-specific rules. Real resolver chapters or a strict description chapter block project onto native item DTOs without synchronous network access, preserving user edits/deletions and intro/credit markers. Exact runtime signatures, operating systems and physical client rendering require separate verification. Running HLS URLs are not automatically renewed on expiry.

flows.title: Native YouTube audio/video compatibility
flows.summary: Exact native hooks prefer client-advertised H264 and, for known mono/stereo or unknown layout, existing AAC on independently validated plugin-owned sources. Preferences use local cloned arrays. An output-only channel cap prevents native unknown-layout six-channel fallback while preserving lower bounds, known multichannel, copy eligibility and truthful source metadata. Missing runtime signatures fail visibly; lazy interface assembly resolution is handled at signature binding. Actual encoded frames, audio channels, timeline and unaffected ordinary media require tests separate from source-map freshness.

flows.title: Pinned managed player-response source subset
flows.summary: A modified MIT source subset is compiled into the plugin. VideoController uses one fixed player identity; the bounded outer transport validates each request and stops on denial. PlayerResponse supplies original format/caption fields; internal BCL helpers replace excluded external packages. No downloaded player JavaScript, client-identity fallback, subprocess, runtime updater or host-termination package is included. Upstream hashes and explicit modifications are recorded separately from local adapter code.

flows.title: Optional per-user keys and channel subscriptions
flows.summary: Independent default-off admin switches enable authenticated, revision-checked personal profile writes. Bounded encrypted owner-only storage retains disabled values without using them. Scoped native channel folders preserve raw video identities; OwnUser isolates personal browsing and Shared adds channel union to the global catalog with its global key. Exact structural native query/view/DTO bindings gate new personal publication; unknown future runtime surfaces require revalidation. Explicit owner/revision request contexts isolate personal API memory/in-flight cache, disable disk/stale fallback, reject stale work and keep global quota separate. Keys travel in headers, never transport URLs. Local subscriptions do not sync Google account subscriptions. Plugin.GetPages registers personal HTML with EnableInUserMenu=true and IsMainConfigPage=true to match Emby Web's PluginConfiguration query; users open avatar -> App settings -> My YouTube. The plugin card excludes user-menu pages, preserving the admin settings target; page classification grants no administration rights. Personal roots are separate from shared contribution profiles: OwnUser subscriptions become flat owner-scoped channel roots; Shared requires an enabled saved personal key. OwnUser folder descendants retain the mode and contribution token, so mode/subscription changes revoke stale materialized entries without refresh; root listing, authorization and requests share this rule; settings navigation is unchanged. Shared contribution folder IDs carry explicit provenance. Unmarked legacy roots require current positive proof: pairwise global admin handle identities persist without keys, bound only to normalized admin SavedItems. Early startup loads them and explicitly resolves missing aliases with a 30-second total wait budget; unproven entries remain denied. Shared legacy proof stays separate and ephemeral. A RAM admin-ID union is not an identity proof. Snapshot-bound publication rejects stale refreshes. User DTOs clear cached counts on request-local item copies. No initial-absence shortcut bypasses later legacy checks. Global DTO/view guards default to pass-through for unrelated native entity types and unmarked missing/cyclic ancestry. Unknown ancestry is denied only with an observed provider prefix; known foreign folder trees pass. Request copies and user-state resets apply only to positively verified YouTube channel ancestry. Root changes are coalesced by generation and persisted as a key-free hashed shape witness only after current observed IDs match all nonempty direct native ExternalIds. Stale/failed/msg/unresolved-channel output cannot stamp; filters remain active throughout. A bounded internal reconciliation covers identity discovery during a scan.

flows.title: Requests, cache and quota accounting
flows.summary: Endpoint wrappers use bounded HTTP with header credentials, hashed memory/in-flight keys, shared disk cache and coalesced misses. Personal request contexts isolate owner/revision work and disable disk/stale fallback. Global quota counts only actual global-key attempts. Upload lists refresh after 55 minutes; other ordinary lists retain six hours. Global-memory and targeted-playlist invalidation have different disk behavior.

flows.title: Playlist change detection
flows.summary: The poller fetches uncached playlist snapshots, persists compact fingerprints and requests a serialized deep refresh for a changed established snapshot; failed fetches are not valid empty snapshots.

flows.title: Playback intent, session state and resume
flows.summary: Legacy playback interception captures explicit start intent and session events maintain guarded resume state/checkpoints. Commands require exact playback identity and transport. Direct mode bypasses these corrections and uses native resume with video streamcopy disabled.

flows.title: Dashboard player and caption boundaries
flows.summary: Outside direct mode dashboard interception rewrites selected external Emby bundles and serves the embedded iframe player. Legacy native caption-off commands do not guarantee visible client behavior; the historical caption metadata source is excluded from compilation. Direct mode serves original resources and native separate subtitle tracks instead.

flows.title: Managed Home sections
flows.summary: The Home manager derives per-user rows from visible saved channel roots, uses plugin-owned IDs and runtime-discovered mutation APIs, and persists reversible aggregate/filter migration state.

flows.title: Artwork, ordering and diagnostics
flows.summary: Providers and item-update hooks restore plugin-owned artwork; queued sort/image writes respect shared scan activity. Shared logging tees to a bounded plugin-owned file.
